title: 2.3.30 Print Settings Advisor
description: Write a switch on filamentType with at least four cases and a default, printing a recommended temperature and speed for each. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Create a variable to switch on
steps.instructions: Create a variable called filamentType and assign it one of: 'PLA', 'ABS', 'PETG', 'TPU'.

steps.title: Write the switch
steps.instructions: Write a switch on filamentType with a case for 'PLA', 'ABS', 'PETG', and 'TPU'. Each case must print a recommended temperature and a recommended print speed for that filament — you choose reasonable numbers. Add a default that prints a message for a filament type you don't recognize. End every case with a break.

steps.title: Comment where fall-through would happen
steps.instructions: Above one of your case labels, write a comment explaining exactly what would print for that filament (and which cases below it) if its break were removed. Don't actually remove the break — the comment is the deliverable.

requirements.title: break present
requirements.description: Code contains at least one break statement

requirements.title: mentions temperature
requirements.description: Code prints a recommended temperature somewhere

requirements.title: mentions speed
requirements.description: Code prints a recommended print speed somewhere
